texto: The vast majority of Dutch nouns form their plural by adding the «-en» desinence (stoel - hstoelen, boek - hoeken). Those nouns that end up in an atone syllable like -, -em, - or -er or words of foreign origin usually add «-s» (leutel) - the leutels, the tafel - the tafels. Some very common words have a special plural, such as «kind» (child) whose plural is «kinderen». All plurals are required to carry «de».

frases.nl: Hoeveel stoelen staan er in de kamer?
frases.en: How many chairs are in the room?

frases.nl: En hoeveel sleutels liggen op tafel?
frases.es: ¿Y cuántas llaves hay en la mesa?
frases.en: And how many keys are on the table?

bloques.pregunta: What is the plural of the «kind» (child) noun in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: «Kind» has a characteristic irregular plural finished in «-eren» («kinderen»).
It adds only - without the particle - er - inside that requires the standard form.
The -s termination does not apply to this historical noun.

bloques.pregunta: What's Sara asking about the furniture?
bloques.frase: Hoeveel stoelen staan er in de kamer?

opciones.texto: How many chairs are in the room.
opciones.explicacion: «Hoeveel» is how many and «stoelen» is the plural of «stoel» (chair).

opciones.texto: How many tables are available in the room.
opciones.explicacion: He does not ask for tables («tafels»), but for chairs.

opciones.texto: Where they've kept the keys to the house.
opciones.explicacion: The question about keys comes next.

bloques.pregunta: Complete the response with the correct «stoel» plural.

opciones.explicacion: It is the regular plural in -in of «stoel».
It is the form of singular, incompatible with the number four («vier»).
It's singular and it means key.

bloques.pregunta: What endpoint of plural does «sleutel» adopt when it ends in the atone desinence -?

opciones.explicacion: The words finished in an atone syllable as - usually form the plural with -s.
It does not duplicate or add - because it would generate an unnatural pronunciation.
The -er termination does not exist as a plural morphem in this word.
«Lezen» is the verb read and «de boeken» books.
They're not buying anything, they're reading.

opciones.texto: They're looking for the keys under the chairs.
opciones.explicacion: They're not looking for objects, they're reading.
«Boeken» is the regular plural with simple open vowel that is pronounced long.
It is the form in singular; after «drie» plural is required.
Although plural, the text mentions two keys and three books («drie boeken»).

bloques.frase: Hoeveel stoelen staan er in de kamer
bloques.traduccion: How many chairs are in the room?
bloques.explicacion: Quantitative interrogative («hoeveel»), plural noun and verb of existence.

intro: It forms and recognizes the plural of the Dutch nouns with the terminations - and -s.
